data.one_liner: Cupertino styled stepper widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a stepper widget that displays progress through a sequence of steps with a Cupertino design. It supports horizontal and vertical layouts and can be used in forms or multi-step wizards.
use_when: Implementing a multi-step form where each step depends on the previous one
Creating a wizard-style UI that requires a clear visual progress indicator
Building a Cupertino-styled app that needs native iOS look and feel
avoid_when: You need extensive customization beyond the provided properties
You are building a web-only application that does not support Cupertino widgets
weaknesses: No advanced customization options beyond basic styling
Not a full widget set or UI kit
